about.title: About
about.missionIntro: We're on a mission to make parking and personal item management smarter, safer, and more privacy-friendly for everyone.
about.missionText1: RAABTA TAG was created to solve a common problem: how to allow others to contact you about your vehicle or personal items without sharing your private phone number.
about.missionText2: Whether it's a car parked in a busy area, keys left at a café, or a tablet forgotten at a friend's house, our QR code system provides a simple, secure way to connect people while protecting your privacy.
about.missionText3: We support both vehicle owners and individuals who want to track their personal belongings. Generate QR codes, download them, and use them anywhere—completely free.
about.offerVehicleText: Register your vehicle and get a unique QR code. When someone needs to contact you about your parked car, they simply scan the code and send you a message—without ever seeing your phone number.
about.offerItemText: Register any personal belonging—keys, phone, tablet, wallet, bag, and more. Generate QR codes for each item so they can be easily identified and returned if lost.
about.communityText: Start protecting your privacy and simplifying your life with QR codes today.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about RAABTA TAG, smart parking QR codes, privacy, and lost item recovery.
faq.q1: How does RAABTA TAG protect my privacy?
faq.a1: RAABTA TAG uses dynamic QR codes to connect you with others. When someone scans your vehicle or personal item QR code, they can send you a message or call you through our secure platform without ever seeing your actual phone number. Your personal contact details remain completely hidden.
faq.q2: Is RAABTA TAG free to use?
faq.a2: Yes, generating basic QR codes for your vehicles and personal items is completely free. There are no hidden charges, subscription fees, or credit card requirements. Premium features may be offered in the future.
faq.q3: What happens if I lose my personal item?
faq.a3: If your item has a RAABTA TAG QR code on it, anyone who finds it can scan the code to notify you instantly, helping you recover your lost belongings safely and anonymously. The finder can contact you without seeing your personal information.
faq.a4: Yes, you can register multiple vehicles under one account. Each vehicle receives its own unique dynamic QR code, so you can manage parking communication for all your vehicles from a single dashboard.
faq.q5: How do I get my QR code sticker?
faq.a5: Once your vehicle or item is approved by our admin team, you can download a high-quality QR code image in PNG format. You can print it yourself as a dashboard tag, or contact us for professional sticker options.
faq.q6: What types of personal items can I register?
faq.a6: You can register keys, mobile phones, tablets, wallets, bags, backpacks, laptops, and almost any personal belonging. Each item gets its own unique QR code for easy identification and recovery if lost.
faq.q7: How does the dynamic QR code work?
faq.a7: A dynamic QR code links to a secure RAABTA TAG profile page that changes in real-time. When someone scans it, they see your vehicle or item information and can contact you through our platform — all without exposing your personal phone number.
faq.q8: Is RAABTA TAG available outside Pakistan?
faq.a8: Currently RAABTA TAG primarily serves users in Pakistan, but our QR code system can work anywhere in the world. International users are welcome to register and use our service.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At RAABTA TAG, your privacy is our top priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our smart parking QR code and personal item tracking services.
privacyPolicy.section1Text: We collect information you provide directly to us when you register a vehicle or personal item, including your name, email address, phone number, vehicle details (name, number, color, address), and personal item descriptions. We also collect usage data including QR code scans and communication timestamps to improve our service.
privacyPolicy.section2Text: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, including generating dynamic QR codes, facilitating anonymous communication between users, processing vehicle and item registrations, and sending notifications when your QR code is scanned.
privacyPolicy.section3Text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Your phone number is never shared publicly. All communication is routed through our secure platform to maintain your anonymity.
privacyPolicy.section4Text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at raabtatag@gmail.com.
